verdicts.reason: The two candidates look essentially identical, and both break in the same ways. The S-A-L-E circle stack is pulled apart: the letters are scattered across the banner while their white circles sit empty in a tiny vertical column in the middle, so the word SALE no longer reads. The scattered letters also collide with shrunken lantern and cloud artwork, and the decorative elements are reduced to illegible specks next to an oversized 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' block.
